symmetry_reduction: For odd L (integer spin), the full block-diagonal matrix transposes under alpha->2-alpha. For L=42, the half-integer spin global sign acts on the full matrix and leaves every even principal minor invariant. For even L<42, the sign acts only on the active block while the idle complement stays identity; odd-size active subminors therefore change sign, so no reduction is made for those lengths.
